title: Welt reply event
description: One event of the agent's reply stream, specified in prose by docs/wire.md. Unlike the request payload, this direction is not a rejection contract: Welt reads the six keys named here and ignores everything else. So this states one thing only — if an event carries one of the six, this is the shape Welt reads it in. Everything else about the event is the framework's own business.

data.description: A chunk of the streamed reply, rendered as standard Markdown.

currentToolUse.description: A tool the agent is invoking. Welt renders an indicator for it, and takes the fields it recognizes from whatever the framework's own event carries.

toolResult.description: A finished tool, which closes that tool's indicator.

file.description: A file the agent produced, which Welt uploads into the thread.

bytes.description: The file's content, base64-encoded. Welt does refuse a string that fails to decode, which no schema keyword asserts.

interrupt.description: A question the run stopped on. Welt renders one per pending interrupt and resumes once every one is answered.

id.description: Identifies the question in the resume payload.

reason.description: Any JSON value; its shape alone decides the rendering. The structured shape renders as the widgets it specifies, a non-empty string as that text, anything else as pretty-printed JSON — the latter two with the default Approve / Deny buttons.

error.description: A reply failure, normally emitted by the AgentCore Runtime SDK when the agent raises mid-stream rather than by an adapter.

structuredReason.description: The interrupt reason Welt renders as a message with widgets. Matching is all-or-nothing: a reason that fails this falls back to the default rendering rather than being partly repaired.

message.description: The question body, rendered as standard Markdown.

options.description: The choice buttons, at most what one Slack actions block holds.

value.description: The answer the interrupting tool receives when the button is pressed.

label.description: The button text; defaults to the value.

interruptInput.description: The free-text field whose submitted text becomes the answer.

multiline.description: Whether the field takes more than one line; defaults to false.
